text:
Alex: quick question — I'm doing a staging backfill for secret claims. PR adds a ClaimSet CRD that maps logical keys to k8s secret names. Terraform will create the new svcaccounts. Can someone sanity-check the wiring before I merge?

Priya: link? also, which flow are you using to populate the secrets — controller that writes k8s Secrets, or ExternalSecrets that pulls from Vault?

Alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4921 
It's the controller that materializes k8s Secrets from the ClaimSet. Vault is the source of truth. We opted for controller to avoid ExternalSecrets rate limits during backfill.

Mateo: quick read: looks ok but watch for ordering between svcaccount creation + rolebinding and the controller reconciling ClaimSet. If controller sees ClaimSet before creds exist it will create empty Secret and then the backfill job might overwrite — risky for consumers.

Jules: what if we add an annotation to stall reconciliation until the service account token is present? e.g.:
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    secret-sync.redwood.com/claimset-paused: "true"
```
Controller can skip ClaimSets with that annotation and we flip it after TF finishes.

Priya: that seems safer than finalizers. Another option: run a one-off backfill job that creates the Secrets with the expected data, then remove the annotation so controller will be no-op (or reconcile idempotently).

Mateo: agree. Also add a TTL label on the backfilled secrets so cleanup is easier if something goes wrong: `redwood/backfill=true` and `redwood/backfill-ts=2026-03-15T12:00:00Z`.

Alex: thanks. One more question — rotation: Vault will rotate creds soon after provisioning. Do we have a handoff so controller refreshes secrets when Vault rotation occurs, or do we rely on vault-sync?

Jules: controller listens to Vault webhook events via the vault-proxy. As long as the secret path is the same, controller will update k8s Secret. For rotation safety, ensure the ClaimSet points at the Vault path, not at a static version.

Alex: got it. I'll: 1) add `claimset-paused:true` annotation in the TF overlay, 2) run the backfill job to create Secrets with backfill labels, 3) remove the annotation and smoke test.

ops-bot: CI: platform/claimset-controller — build passed :white_check_mark: (1749123468)

Priya: ping me when you remove the annotation and I will run the smoke test (small curl against staging endpoint).

Mateo: one caveat — if the backfill job uses `kubectl create secret generic` make sure the secret type is `kubernetes.io/service-account-token` if downstream expects that. Otherwise consumer code might mis-handle it.

Alex: good catch, Mateo. I'll create service-account-token format and include the annotations. Will post the run log here after backfill.

Jules: LGTM. :thumbsup:

Alex: backfill done, removed annotation, running smoke checks now. I'll update shortly.

Alex: smoke checks all green, consumers served keys, rotation watch observed and updated one rotated secret. Closing — thanks all. :tada:
